definitions.gloss: now on sale; currently available for purchase
definitions.explanation: Indicates that a product, ticket, or item is currently being sold. Very commonly seen on signs, advertisements, and product packaging.

examples.japanese: チケット{発売中|はつばいちゅう}。
{新刊|しんかん}が{好評|こうひょう}{発売中|はつばいちゅう}です。
examples.english: The new book is on sale and well received.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}{限定|げんてい}フレーバーのアイスが{全国|ぜんこく}のコンビニで{発売中|はつばいちゅう}なので、{見|み}かけたらぜひ{試|ため}してみてください。
examples.english: A summer-limited ice cream flavor is currently on sale at convenience stores nationwide, so if you see it, definitely give it a try.

notes:
Composed of {発売|はつばい} (sale, release) + {中|ちゅう} (during, in progress). One of many 〜{中|ちゅう} compounds indicating an ongoing state. Extremely common in advertising, store signage, and product announcements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {好評|こうひょう}{発売中|はつばいちゅう}: on sale to great acclaim
- {絶賛|ぜっさん}{発売中|はつばいちゅう}: now on sale (emphatic marketing phrase)
- {数量|すうりょう}{限定|げんてい}{発売中|はつばいちゅう}: on sale in limited quantities
- {全国|ぜんこく}で{発売中|はつばいちゅう}: on sale nationwide

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {販売中|はんばいちゅう}: currently selling — very similar, slightly more formal
- {発売|はつばい}: release, sale — the action of putting something on sale
- {売|う}り{出|だ}し{中|ちゅう}: on sale, special sale in progress — often implies a promotional sale
